schedules.meaning: Schedule status views in schedule_id order.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The enum lists fixed literal outcomes. Open forms can also appear: <raw SQLite or filesystem error text> and <stored JSON parser error text>.

first_missing_signal.meaning: HTTP refusal field, identical to firstMissingSignal on that refusal. Open forms are the same HTTP refusal forms described for firstMissingSignal.
